block_3_body.fallback_provenance_rule: Monolith, floppy preset, and ROM-hydrated configs stamp loaded_from_data = false unconditionally.
block_3_body.dump_card_signature_and_width_rule: Cards target 60-column inner width (or 62-char +---+ box borders with aligned right pipes). io/ and viewport operational APIs return character counts (size_t/int); fallback BIOS twins match existing subsystem callers unless normalized in coordinated facade updates.
block_3_body.dump_card_domain_neutrality_rule: Engine diagnostic dump cards format generic slot data or inspection_cards.json schema templates with zero hardcoded game-specific character or relic lore.
